title: Snake
lastAssistantText:
Done. The deliverable is `index.html` (single file, fully offline, no external dependencies).

## What was built

A complete Snake game with all requested features:

- **Keyboard controls** — Arrow keys or WASD to steer
- **Food** — randomly placed, never spawns on the snake
- **Scoring** — +1 per food; best score persisted via `localStorage`
- **Wall collision** — game over on hitting the border
- **Self collision** — game over on hitting your own body (tail-vacated cell correctly allowed)
- **Pause/Resume** — `Space` toggles pause with an overlay
- **Restart** — `R` anytime, or the Play/Play-again button
- **Increasing difficulty** — level rises every 5 food; step interval shrinks from 140ms toward a 60ms floor
- Extras: swipe controls for touch, rounded graphics with eyes that follow movement direction, live Score/Best/Level readout

## Verification

1. **Syntax check** — extracted the `<script>` and ran `node --check` → OK
2. **Headless logic simulation** — drove the exact game algorithms through scenarios:
   - eating food grows the snake (3→6) ✓
   - reversing direction is rejected ✓
   - valid turns apply ✓
   - wall collision detected ✓
   - self collision detected ✓
   - leveling and speed ramp/floor ✓

All passed.

## One bug caught and fixed during testing

The initial code did `snake.unshift(head)` then always `snake.pop()`, so eating food produced **no net growth**. Fixed so the tail is only removed when not growing.
